Summary: the macOS test gate was only ever dropped in one place — `release-binaries.yml` (commit bfe9cbf). CI (`ci.yml`) never lost its mac gate, so it needed verification, not an edit. I restored the release gate and added the missing mac test step to the manual packaging workflow:

- `.github/workflows/release-binaries.yml` — replaced the "gate dropped for 0.0.1" comment with the original `- run: cargo test --locked` step, in its original position (after the universal build, before Package). The macos job now runs: targets → universal build → `cargo test` → package → dmg verify. A red mac test fails the job, which blocks `release-native.yml` publication end to end.
- `.github/workflows/release.yml` — added "Run macOS tests before packaging" (`cargo test --locked`) to the macos job only, between build and package (same build→test→package order as `release-binaries.yml` and CI), with the same `DEVELOPER_DIR`/`MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` env as the neighboring build step. Linux job untouched.
- `RELEASING.md` — two-line note documenting that both packaging workflows run the macOS `cargo test` gate before bundling.
- Checked and deliberately left unchanged: `ci.yml` (matrix already `[ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]`, `cargo build --release --locked` + `cargo test --locked` run unconditionally on both — no mac-only deps step is needed since mac runners carry Xcode/system frameworks); `release-native.yml` (inherits the restored gate via `release-binaries.yml`); `release-gate.yml` and `release-checks.yml` (ubuntu-only orchestration/script checks — no mac step applicable).

Files changed (uncommitted, as instructed — no commit, no push, branch untouched): diff stat is 3 files, +9/−2 (`release-binaries.yml`, `release.yml`, `RELEASING.md`). Full diff reviewed above; all edits are scoped to mac jobs/docs, Linux behavior unchanged.

Verification: all 7 workflow YAMLs parse (no PyYAML available, verified with `ruby -RYAML` `YAML.safe_load` — all OK) and step order inspected programmatically: macos job in `release-binaries.yml` runs `cargo test --locked` before Package; `release.yml` macos job runs Build → Run macOS tests → Package; CI matrix confirmed `[ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]` with unconditional build+test steps. No Rust tests were run (no `src/` changes, so none needed).

What still needs a real mac runner: (1) whether `cargo test` actually goes green on `macos-latest` — the gate was dropped for 8 failing stale-chrome asserts and nothing since base 4104d2b fixes tests, so the first gated run may be red until test fixes land; dispatch CI on this branch to confirm; (2) headless/GUI risk — the suite uses gpui `AppContext` across ~30 test modules and the repo history notes a macOS invisible-text/font-kit issue, so text-rendering tests may behave differently without a display; (3) timing — the restored test step adds a dev-profile build after two `--release` universal builds inside the 45-min macos job timeout; watch the first run.

Open questions: none blocking — but if the first mac CI run is red on test asserts (not infra), that is a test-fix task, not a workflow task, and should be filed separately rather than re-dropping the gate.
